request.query: Roth theorem parameters exists small delta fixed m 16 n squared square root

items.name: roth_3ap_theorem_nat
items.type: ∀ {n : ℕ} (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → cornersTheoremBound (ε / 3) ≤ n → ∀ A ⊆ Finset.range n, ε * ↑n ≤ ↑A.card → ¬ThreeAPFree ↑A

items.name: roth_3ap_theorem
items.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : Fintype G] (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε → cornersTheoremBound ε ≤ Fintype.card G → ∀ (A : Finset G), ε * ↑(Fintype.card G) ≤ ↑A.card → ¬ThreeAPFree ↑A

items.name: ThreeAPFree.le_rothNumberNat
items.type: ∀ {k n : ℕ} (s : Finset ℕ), ThreeAPFree ↑s → (∀ x ∈ s, x < n) → s.card = k → k ≤ rothNumberNat n

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux'
items.type: ∀ (n d : ℕ), ↑(d ^ n) / ↑(n * d ^ 2) ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))
